hiring_intel.senior_backend_market: 58% of backend roles require 5+ years; 24,600+ active backend roles; avg listed salary $145-185k US; AWS in 55% of listings; cloud overall 72%; top candidates combine primary language + cloud + Docker/K8s + Postgres/Redis/Kafka (40% of senior requirements)
hiring_intel.full_stack_roadmap: TypeScript won as lingua franca; fundamentals (HTTP, algorithms) matter; T-shaped engineers preferred; over-broad job descriptions are red flags
hiring_intel.framework_choice: NestJS default for TS product teams; FastAPI if AI/data core; Spring Boot/.NET for health/finance enterprise with platform teams; Go for latency-bound services; Django/Rails fastest CRUD but slower senior hiring
hiring_intel.github_portfolio: hiring managers value depth over breadth: 2-4 polished projects with clear READMEs, architecture decisions, tests, CI/CD, deployment, and measurable impact; toy apps without context do not convert

tangerine_recommendation.rationale: Tangerine is health-data-heavy and regulated (consents, audit logs, credential verification, FHIR-lite later). Hiring appeal plus compliance favors a TS full-stack core for velocity and hiring pool, with Python AI/data services for biomarker interpretation, reserving Go for throughput-bound gateway services.

recommended_stack.backend_core: NestJS (TypeScript) modular monolith initially, extracted services later
recommended_stack.ai_data_service: FastAPI (Python) for biomarker/AI interpretation and data pipelines
recommended_stack.database: PostgreSQL with row-level security and pgvector (embeddings for AI search)
recommended_stack.cache_queues: Redis (Upstash/ElastiCache) for sessions, rate limits, job queues; BullMQ
recommended_stack.events: Kafka (or managed event bus) only from Phase 5+ at event-volume justification; start with transactional outbox + Redis streams
recommended_stack.orm: Drizzle (performance, type-safety, small bundles) with strong migration discipline
recommended_stack.api_layer: tRPC for internal app-to-backend; REST/OpenAPI for external/public/partner integrations
recommended_stack.monorepo: Turborepo + pnpm for web/api/mobile packages; move to Nx if >5 teams/apps
recommended_stack.infra: Docker, managed Kubernetes/ECS after platform maturity, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, SOC2/HIPAA-aligned cloud, data residency controls
recommended_stack.mobile_logging: React Native (Expo) sharing TS types via monorepo

avoid_early: full Kubernetes self-hosting before platform maturity
separate frontend/backend repos before team scale

milestone_gates.gate_1: Phase 0-1 shipped on TS monolith + Postgres + Redis; observability baseline
milestone_gates.gate_2: AI surface (FastAPI) when biomarker interpretation ships (Phase 3/9)
milestone_gates.gate_3: event streaming and managed K8s when throughput/SLAs demand (Phase 5+)
